sam_sales: Heads-up 1: AsteriaAI signed a 12-week pilot (midmarket). Primary contact: daniel@asteria.ai. Main asks: private deployment (VPC peering), SAML SSO, ability to bulk upload embeddings (S3 + presigned), and custom KMS. Expected traffic: 3-7 QPS, mostly steady weekdays, ~30k tokens/day. Pilot target region: eu-central-1. Pilot end date: 2026-07-20. Assigning @rachel_cs to run onboarding and @omar_eng to own the private eval. Can ops/support confirm any special billing or compliance steps? :wave:
rachel_cs: I'll take this. Next steps I'm planning: (1) kickoff call with Asteria and engineering; (2) collect SAML metadata + S3 bucket policy + KMS ARN; (3) share CS onboarding checklist and success criteria template (latency SLA, availability target, embedding accuracy checks). Proposed kickoff: Tue 11am CET. Can Daniel do that? :calendar:
omar_eng: For private eval sizing we need their expected max context (they said 4k) and whether embedding uploads will be batched or streaming. With 4k context and that QPS, small cluster (~2 GPU nodes) should be fine. If they want encryption with their KMS we need IAM role and key policy. Typical spin-up is 3-5 business days once all artifacts are provided. Also please confirm their model family (they mentioned 'redwood-llm-4k').
lee_support: I'll create a lightweight runbook and a dedicated support tag: #asteria-pilot. Recommend enabling detailed logs for the first 72h and adding a PagerDuty rotation for the pilot window. I'll reuse the private-eval smoke tests but add an embedding-validation step.
maria_ops: Ops note: ensure the SOW includes private-deploy addendum and EU data residency clause. Confirm billing frequency (monthly) and whether they pre-paid. Sam, can you attach the signed SOW?
sam_sales: Uploading SOW to internal drive: https://redwood.internal/agreements/asteria-sow-1961 (internal link). They signed the security addendum and requested strict EU-only data. Daniel confirmed kickoff Tue 11am CET. He'll send SAML and KMS info by EOD tomorrow.
omar_eng: EU-only noted. Checklist for customer artifacts needed: (a) SAML metadata XML, (b) VPC CIDR + peering contact + ASNs if needed, (c) KMS ARN + IAM role for service account, (d) sample request/response payloads (avg token lengths). If they plan to upload embeddings via S3, we need bucket name and presign policy or cross-account role. Example minimal SAML snippet we accept: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.asteria.ai">...```
rachel_cs: I'll schedule the kickoff and send the onboarding checklist now. Action items I'll own: invite + agenda, capture success metrics, coordinate SSO test window. Owners recap: Sam (Sales) -> SOW + customer follow-ups; Rachel (CS) -> onboarding + success metrics; Omar (Eng) -> private eval + sizing; Lee (Support) -> runbook + PD; Maria (Ops) -> billing/contract confirmation.
deploy-bot: private-eval created => REF# PE-2026-95; owner: omar_eng; region: eu-central-1; status: waiting-for-customer-artifacts.
lee_support: After kickoff I'll draft the runbook and post a short checklist here: auth, generation sample, embedding upload validate, latency smoke. Recommend a 48h monitoring window after go-live with daily health posts.
sam_sales: Thanks team 10. I'll follow up with Daniel for the artifacts and post updates. Please flag any blockers here. :thumbsup:
rachel_cs: Posting checklist and kickoff invite now. Will update thread with progress and the first status update after kickoff. :white_check_mark:
